observable_state_rules.observed: The observable prerequisite is established and at least one applicable facet is observed.
observable_state_rules.insufficient: The observable may apply but the prerequisite or all applicable facet distinctions lack sufficient evidence.
observable_state_rules.not_applicable: The observable prerequisite is affirmatively established as absent in the bounded response scope.

facet_state_rules.observed: At least one allowed value assertion is supported in this facet.
facet_state_rules.insufficient: The facet is applicable but no allowed value can be supported without inference.
facet_state_rules.not_applicable: A facet-specific prerequisite is affirmatively absent.

response_state_scope.empty_assertion_rule: A facet or event_stage whose state is insufficient or not_applicable contains no substantive value assertions.
response_state_scope.nonmention_rule: Non-mention, unknown content, transcript silence, or an incomplete evidence frame yields insufficient, never not_applicable or established nonoccurrence.

rules: One observable_response may contain one or more facet_groups.
No global value_relation field is permitted.
Every referenced facet_group, event_stage, assertion, source provenance item, absence condition, and evidence unit is locally unique.
Cardinality is evaluated within the facet, not across the observable.
Multiple values in one facet require either distinct components, distinct event_stages, or an explicit multiple-copresence rule in the codebook overlay.
Cross-facet assertions may be co-present without being placed in a temporal sequence.
One event_stage represents one bounded act, utterance, decision, or meaningful status transition.
All source_provenance_ids form the exact source set supporting the event_stage boundary and content.
Assertions on the same event_stage are co-present unless a separate event_stage and temporal edge is supplied.
Several facet labels on one event_stage do not create several behavioral events.
Every observed assertion has a nonempty exact source provenance set.
Every assertion binds to exactly one event_stage and the same evidence_unit_id used by that event_stage.
A hybrid parent value is observed only when every required component_assertion is observed.
An observed affirmative component may be retained when its paired absence component is insufficient, but the hybrid parent value is then not selected.
An absence-dependent value with no established absence condition is not an observed parent assertion.
An affirmative component is observed only from positive report content and never from failure to mention an alternative action.
An absence component is observed only when absence_condition_id names a fully established gate for that exact component.
absence_condition_id is null for an affirmative component and required for an absence component.
An insufficient component carries no substantive proposition assertion but may retain missingness and uncertainty at its event_stage.
Component-level state preserves observed affirmative behavior even when the full hybrid parent value cannot be selected.
All four gate fields must be established before the qualified absence component is observed.
The source_provenance_ids are the exact source set for the named absence target, window, and gate facts.
A gate cannot be reused for a different absent proposition, actor, or window.
Missing or partial reporting cannot set established_nonoccurrence to established.
Every cited source_record_id must belong to the supplied coding task.
An event_stage and each assertion/component carry their own exact provenance set; one set is not silently inherited as proof of a different claim.
Summary or orientation text cannot replace exact primary-source provenance.
All labels derived from one act, utterance, choice, terminal course, or endpoint trajectory share an evidence unit unless a genuinely new opportunity is established.
Specificity, extra facets, extra labels, and derived trajectories never increase the independent evidence count.
Repeated-series self-report and self-selected examples follow the recurrence-v2 evidence firewall.
Temporal edges form an acyclic partial order.
An edge is added only when order is established by exact source evidence.
No edge is created merely from array position or cross-facet co-presence.
Unknown order remains unrepresented and may carry an uncertainty flag.

copresence.representation: Assertions that reference the same event_stage_id are co-present.
rules: Co-presence is compatible with different facet_ids.
Co-presence never implies simultaneity finer than the event_stage boundary and never implies temporal order.
Co-present assertions use the same evidence_unit_id.

specificity_and_precedence.default_rule: Within one facet and event_stage, retain the narrowest supported value and suppress any broad value that adds no distinct sourced fact.
specificity_and_precedence.cumulative_rule: Broad and narrow values may both be asserted only for different sourced components or different event_stages; assertions from the same behavioral occurrence still share one evidence unit.
specificity_and_precedence.composite_rule: A composite trajectory is represented by component assertions and temporal edges. If a retained derived label is displayed, its specificity_disposition is derived_not_countable and it creates no evidence unit.
specificity_and_precedence.uncertain_boundary_rule: If the required boundary fact is not established, the affected facet is insufficient; the coder does not select among competing values by intuition.

R05-O2.affirmative: acceptance or selection of an existing option or designated default
R05-O2.absence: no additional alternative search during the named feasible preselection search opportunity

R07-i.absence: no transition to focal action during the named feasible observed period

R15-b.absence: no completion by the defined due point or condition

R15-c.affirmative: completion of one or more named endpoint components
R15-c.absence: noncompletion of one or more other named endpoint components during the assessment window

R16-c.absence: no request during the named feasible pre-prompt request opportunity

R16-d2.absence: no direct help request during the named feasible request window

R16-f.absence: no use of the accepted help during the named feasible use window

R18-d.affirmative: communication of a named subset of the relevant condition
R18-d.absence: no communication of a named remaining part during a sufficiently observed feasible communication opportunity

R18-f.absence: no communication of the named condition during the defined feasible preconsequence window

R20-j.affirmative: repetition of the narrator's previously stated position
R20-j.absence: no address, answer, or other engagement with the other party's identified content during the defined exchange

R21-f.absence: no discussion of the recognized rupture during the relevant resumed-contact interaction or named feasible discussion opportunity

R21-i.absence: no repair action during the initial named feasible repair window

default_observable_profile.applies_to: Any codebook observable without a more specific profile below.

substantive_response.value_ids_source: The allowed values in the bound versioned codebook.

rules: Co-present assertions attach to one event_stage; sourced sequential actions use separate event_stages and temporal edges.
The global invariants, evidence-unit rule, specificity rule, and exact absence-condition rule apply unchanged.

choice_resolution.multiple_rule: Multiple resolution values require distinct components or ordered event_stages under the codebook precedence rules.

later_goal_status.multiple_rule: Multiple values require distinct status components or ordered stages; G6 and G7 require distinct stop and follow-up evidence.

invariants.rule: Every observed value assertion binds to one facet, one event_stage, one evidence unit, and a nonempty exact source provenance set.
No observable-level global relation may impose one order on all selected values.
Temporal order exists only as sourced edges between event_stage identities and must be acyclic.
Assertions on one event_stage are co-present; array order has no temporal meaning.
All assertions derived from the same behavioral act or trajectory share one evidence unit and count at most once as occurrence support.
Specificity and number of facet labels never establish independence.
Every absence condition names exactly one absent actor, proposition, and window; all four gate elements must be established from exact provenance.
Unknown, not reported, transcript silence, or a partial evidence frame cannot establish nonoccurrence.
A more specific value suppresses a broad value for the same facet fact unless distinct sourced components or stages are represented.
A derived or composite trajectory creates no evidence unit beyond its component events.
An insufficient or not_applicable scope contains no substantive value assertion.
Not_applicable requires affirmative absence of the relevant prerequisite; non-mention is insufficient.
Historical v1 and v2 records are never reinterpreted in place; v3 responses use new schema identity and explicit source-version bindings.

The contract is compatible with theory-blind human and automated coding because both receive the same codebook overlay, facet profile, exact evidence, precedence rules, and absence gates while remaining label-isolated.

blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-029: NBM-R05 can place option-construction or search-disposition assertions on an event_stage while preserving a partial order among separate resolution stages; no false cross-facet order is created.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-034: NBM-R07 preparation-type assertions may be co-present on one preparation stage, while a later R07-i transition-status stage is temporally ordered and carries its own absence condition.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-085: NBM-R16 request and offer stages preserve chronology while help type, source breadth, and use assertions attach co-presently to the relevant stage.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-114: NBM-R20 stores each dialogue turn as an event_stage, permits content and escalation assertions on one turn, and orders only sourced turns.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-121: NBM-R21 stores co-present repair content, origin, and channel on a repair event while timing, contact disposition, later repair, and withdrawal remain ordered stages.
